from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Party(BaseModel):
    """A legal party mentioned in the document with their role."""
    name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the party as written in the document")
    role: str | None = Field(description="The legal role, e.g., Appellant, Appellee, Petitioner, Respondent")

class FinancialDetail(BaseModel):
    """A financial obligation or cost mentioned in the document."""
    amount: str | None = Field(description="The amount as written (e.g., '1000 元')")
    type: str | None = Field(description="The type of cost, e.g., Appeal Fee, Compensation, Court Cost")
    bearer: str | None = Field(description="Who bears the cost")

class Document(BaseModel):
    """Extracted evidence from a single legal document needed for matching."""
    document_id: str | None = Field(description="An identifier for the document, e.g., '判决文书1'")
    parties: list[Party] = Field(default_factory=list, description="List of parties involved")
    case_numbers: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list, description="Case numbers mentioned")
    court: str | None = Field(description="The court name mentioned")
    dispute_type: str | None = Field(description="Type of dispute, e.g., Property Rights, Divorce")
    outcome_summary: str | None = Field(description="The main ruling or disposition (e.g., '驳回上诉，维持原判')")
    financial_details: list[FinancialDetail] = Field(default_factory=list, description="Fees, compensation, and costs")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[Document]
